verdict.rationale: WezTerm's own GitHub description says it is a GPU-accelerated terminal emulator, and some users report it is fast (faster than iTerm2; fast pane splitting and resizing). However, hands-on reports describe scrolling and cursor lag on macOS, higher latency than Kitty with lines painted blank in vim, and higher input latency than cmd.exe on Windows. Nothing documents how it performs under heavy output. Missing for 10: first-party documentation or benchmarks of throughput and responsiveness under heavy output, and consistent cross-platform evidence of low latency (macOS and Windows lag reports undercut it).

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on GPU-accelerated rendering that stays fast and responsive under heavy output
